name: Best Nurse Ever Ceramic Mug (11 oz)
seoTitle: Best Nurse Ever Mug Gift for Nurses
metaDescription: A Best Nurse Ever ceramic mug in an 11 oz size, a simple and cheerful gift for Nurses Week, birthdays, Christmas, or nursing school graduation.
summary: A cheerful Best Nurse Ever mug that fits nearly any gift moment, from Nurses Week to birthdays, and gets used every single morning.
whyItWorks: Coffee is practically part of the uniform. Day shift starts with it, night shift survives on it, and the break room pot rarely gets a rest. A mug is one of the few gifts a nurse will actually use every day, and a Best Nurse Ever message turns that morning cup into a small daily reminder that someone noticed.

The 11 oz size is a standard coffee cup, easy to wrap and easy to give. It covers a long list of occasions without feeling forced: Nurses Week, a birthday, Christmas, Mother's Day, or a graduation gift for someone who just finished nursing school. It also works as a thank you from a patient's family, since the message is warm and simple. Fill it with a bag of good coffee beans, a few tea bags, or wrapped chocolates and it becomes a complete gift without much extra effort. It is the kind of present that keeps showing up in the kitchen for years.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for whether it is dishwasher and microwave safe.
Nurses who carry drinks on shift may prefer a lidded tumbler, so this one is best for home or the break room.
Fill it with coffee or candy to make it feel more complete.

faq.q: Is a mug too ordinary a gift for a nurse?
faq.a: Mugs are common, but they get used daily. A nurse specific message and some coffee inside make it feel personal.

faq.q: Can it be used at work?
faq.a: It works well in a break room. Open mugs are not allowed at most nurses stations, so it is mainly for breaks and home.
